source:
@@U03273@@
I'd never laid eyes on 福玻斯, or 阿瑞斯, or 赫耳墨斯 and all the others—and then, there before me, I saw him, and in seeing I saw what men can only praise as divine. Born to be a king, in youth he was glorious to see, subject to his elder brother, though also, no less, to the loveliest of women. Earth will never see his like again, nor 赫柏 lead him into heaven. Poets will labor in vain to sing his praises, and sculptors torture stone to make his image.

@@U03275@@
Let sculptors boast all they like, no one has ever portrayed him as well as your words. Having spoken now of the most splendid of men, tell me of the loveliest of women.

@@U03277@@
What! Female beauty! Female beauty is nothing, a rigid, lifeless image! I reserve my praise for those whose being is a fountain of joy in life. Beauty is its own obsession, its own bliss. Ah, but add to it Grace, and it becomes irresistible, charm that escapes the contemplative and surges to active devotion. Like 海伦 when I carried her.

@@U03279@@
Carried her?

@@U03281@@
Yes, on this back.
translation:
@@U03273@@
我从来没有见过福玻斯、阿瑞斯、赫耳墨斯以及所有其他人——然后，就在我面前，我看到了他，在看到的过程中，我看到了人们只能称赞为神圣的东西。生来就是一个国王，年轻时他很光荣，臣服于他的哥哥，但也同样臣服于最可爱的女人。人间再也见不到他这样的人，赫柏也不会带他进入天堂。诗人徒劳地歌颂他，雕塑家折磨石头来塑造他的形象。

@@U03275@@
让雕塑家们尽情夸耀吧，从来没有人像你的文字那样描绘过他。讲完了最出色的男人，现在请告诉我最可爱的女人。

@@U03277@@
什么！女性之美！女性的美什么都不是，是僵化的、死气沉沉的形象！我对那些成为生命快乐源泉的人表示赞扬。美是它自己的痴迷，它自己的幸福。啊，但加上恩典，它就变得不可抗拒，魅力超越沉思，涌向积极的奉献。就像我抱着她时的海伦一样。

@@U03279@@
抱着她？

@@U03281@@
是的，在这个背面。
